description: This source file defines the NotesDbHelper class, an implementation of SQLiteOpenHelper for managing a local notes database within an Android application. It handles database creation, upgrading, and provides schema constants.

classes.name: NotesDbHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing the SQLite database used to store notes within the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table and index in the database.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping and recreating the notes table.
